segments.en: Can I write a server, or does the process just exit? · Glyph
segments.tr: 能写服务器吗，还是进程直接就退出了？ · Glyph

segments.en: A Glyph program can be a long-running server. main sets up and returns; the process stays alive while sockets and timers are pending, exactly as Node does.
segments.tr: Glyph 程序可以是长时间运行的服务器。main 完成初始化后返回；只要还有挂起的 socket 和定时器，进程就保持运行，和 Node 的做法完全一样。

segments.en: 19 · Servers & daemons
segments.tr: 19 · 服务器与守护进程

segments.en: Can I write a server, or does the process just exit?
segments.tr: 能写服务器吗，还是进程直接就退出了？

segments.en: You can write a server. main sets things up and returns, and the process stays alive while sockets and timers are still pending, the same rule Node uses. Until 0.1.63 it did not: the runner tore the process down the moment main returned, so a server bound its port and died in the same tick.
segments.tr: 可以写服务器。main 完成初始化后返回，只要还有挂起的 socket 和定时器，进程就保持运行，和 Node 用的是同一条规则。在 0.1.63 之前并非如此：main 一返回，运行器就结束进程，所以服务器绑定端口后在同一个 tick 里就退出了。

segments.en: Why it matters
segments.tr: 为什么这很重要

segments.en: This is the difference between a language that can run a script and one that can run a service. A server, a file watcher, a bot holding a gateway connection, a job runner: none of them finish inside main. They set up handlers and hand the process over to events.
segments.tr: 这就是能运行脚本的语言和能运行服务的语言之间的区别。服务器、文件监视器、保持网关连接的机器人、任务运行器：它们都不会在 main 里结束。它们设置好处理函数，然后把进程交给事件。

segments.en: The old behaviour failed in the worst possible way, which is quietly. glyph run app.glyph --serve 4100 printed nothing, not even the line inside the listen callback, and exited 0. Nothing in the source looked wrong and it type-checked. An agent that hits that has no error to report and no reason to think anything failed.
segments.tr: 旧的行为以最糟糕的方式失败，也就是悄无声息。glyph run app.glyph --serve 4100 什么都不打印，连 listen 回调里的那一行都没有，然后以 0 退出。源码看起来没有任何问题，类型检查也通过了。遇到这种情况的智能体没有错误可报告，也没有理由认为有什么失败了。

segments.tr: 看看实际效果

segments.tr: 一个完整的 TCP 服务器。main 立即返回；只要进程还在，回调就会运行：

segments.en: A server, start to finish
segments.tr: 一个服务器，从头到尾

segments.en: net is a Node builtin, so it is an ordinary import, but it is not one of the six the compiler ships ambient types for (fs, http, path, os, crypto, url). Either install @types/node and the build prefers it, or drop a declaration in .types/net.d.ts next to your source, which is what the chat app does so it needs no dependencies at all.
segments.tr: net 是 Node 内置模块，所以它是普通的导入，但它不在编译器自带环境类型的六个模块（fs、http、path、os、crypto、url）之列。你可以安装 @types/node，构建会优先使用它；也可以在源码旁边放一个 .types/net.d.ts 声明，聊天应用就是这么做的，所以它完全不需要依赖。

segments.en: Two things worth knowing. The return 0 runs before the first client ever connects: it is the code the process will eventually leave with, not a statement about when it leaves. And anything that fails after main has returned has to set its own exit code, because main's return value is already spent. That is what the error handler is for. Without it, a server that cannot bind its port drains its event loop and exits 0, reporting success.
segments.tr: 有两点值得了解。return 0 在第一个客户端连接之前就执行了：它是进程最终退出时使用的退出码，而不是说明进程何时退出。另外，任何在 main 返回之后才失败的东西都必须自己设置退出码，因为 main 的返回值已经用掉了。error 处理函数就是为此而设。没有它，一个无法绑定端口的服务器会在事件循环清空后以 0 退出，报告成功。

segments.en: A real one
segments.tr: 一个真实的例子

segments.en: examples/apps/chat is a chat server holding several TCP clients at once. The parts that do not touch the network stay separate and testable: line reassembly, routing, and the room engine are pure functions checked by @example, and one file talks to sockets.
segments.tr: examples/apps/chat 是一个同时连接多个 TCP 客户端的聊天服务器。不涉及网络的部分保持独立、可测试：行重组、路由和聊天室引擎都是纯函数，由 @example 检查，只有一个文件与 socket 打交道。

segments.en: Three clients connected at once
segments.tr: 三个客户端同时连接

segments.en: TCP does not deliver messages, it delivers bytes, so the tail of a chunk is usually half a line. That reassembly is a pure function with the awkward cases written down as examples rather than provoked over a socket:
segments.tr: TCP 传递的不是消息，而是字节，所以一个数据块的末尾通常是半行。行重组是一个纯函数，棘手的情况都以示例的形式写下来，而不是通过 socket 去触发：

segments.en: The other direction: a long-running client
segments.tr: 反方向：长时间运行的客户端

segments.en: A bot is the same shape pointed outward. examples/apps/discord is a Discord gateway client: it connects over a WebSocket, identifies, heartbeats on the interval the server dictates, tracks a sequence number so a dropped connection resumes rather than starting over, notices when the connection is open but dead, and backs off between reconnects.
segments.tr: 机器人是同样的结构，只是方向朝外。examples/apps/discord 是一个 Discord 网关客户端：它通过 WebSocket 连接、发送身份信息、按服务器指定的间隔发送心跳、记录序列号以便断线后恢复而不是从头开始、发现连接虽然打开但已经失效的情况，并在重连之间退避。

segments.en: The part worth copying is where the logic lives. Deciding what to do about a RECONNECT, a missed heartbeat, or a rejected token is a pure function from a session and one event to a new session and a list of actions. One module carries those actions out on a real socket. That is why the reconnect logic, which is the hard part to get right, is checked by @example rather than by unplugging a network cable:
segments.tr: 值得借鉴的是逻辑放在哪里。如何应对 RECONNECT、错过的心跳或被拒绝的令牌，是一个纯函数：输入一个会话和一个事件，输出新的会话和一组动作。由一个模块在真实的 socket 上执行这些动作。正因如此，重连逻辑这个最难写对的部分是由 @example 检查的，而不是靠拔网线：

segments.en: Those three examples are each a bug that was in the code first. Writing a mock gateway and pointing the bot at it caught one of them. The other two were caught by a second mock written from Discord's documentation instead of from the client, which sends the things a cooperative mock never does: an unprompted heartbeat request, and a close code that means "your token is wrong, stop asking". A mock written by the author of the client only tests the parts of the protocol the author read.
segments.tr: 这三个示例原本都是代码中的 bug。编写一个模拟网关并让机器人连接它，发现了其中一个。另外两个是由第二个模拟网关发现的，它依据 Discord 的文档编写，而不是依据客户端编写，因此会发送配合型的模拟网关从不发送的东西：一个未经请求的心跳请求，以及一个意思是“你的令牌不对，别再问了”的关闭码。由客户端作者编写的模拟网关，只能测试作者读过的那部分协议。

segments.en: Where it stands
segments.tr: 当前状态

segments.en: Shipping today
segments.tr: 现已提供

segments.en: Returning from main sets the exit code without stopping the process, so servers, watchers and event loops run. A program that only computes still exits the moment main returns, with the same code, so nothing about short programs changed. Node builtins like net are ordinary imports, and a program that throws during setup still terminates, now after its diagnostic has reached a piped stderr rather than possibly being truncated by the exit. std/timers schedules work (after, every, cancel, unref) and std/websocket opens a connection, so neither needs a hand-written declaration.
segments.tr: 从 main 返回会设置退出码，但不会停止进程，所以服务器、监视器和事件循环都能运行。只做计算的程序仍然在 main 返回时以同样的退出码立即退出，所以短程序的行为没有任何变化。像 net 这样的 Node 内置模块是普通导入；在初始化期间抛出异常的程序仍然会终止，而且现在会在它的诊断写入管道连接的 stderr 之后才终止，而不是可能被退出截断。std/timers 负责调度工作（after、every、cancel、unref），std/websocket 负责打开连接，所以两者都不需要手写声明。

segments.en: Getting sharper
segments.tr: 正在改进

segments.en: A listener that fails to bind after main has returned exits 0 unless the program says otherwise: process.set_exit_code(1) records the failure without tearing down work still in flight, and process.exit(1) stops immediately. The compiler cannot yet warn that you forgot. And there is still no way to write down that a function does not return, so a server's main carries a return 0 that is never reached.
segments.tr: 在 main 返回后才绑定失败的监听器会以 0 退出，除非程序另行指定：process.set_exit_code(1) 记录失败而不中断仍在进行的工作，process.exit(1) 则立即停止。编译器目前还不能提醒你忘了这一步。另外，现在仍然无法声明一个函数不会返回，所以服务器的 main 带着一个永远执行不到的 return 0。
